description: Charted Accounting of Sri Lanka - Changes to Sri Lanka Accounting Standards with Effect From 01 st January 2024
reasoning: This gazette content involves the publication of updated Sri Lanka Accounting Standards under the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995.
